map.概率口径：单次第一名是 1/N；抽 n 人（不放回）时，任意 1 人被抽中的概率: Probability: the chance of winning the first slot is 1/N; when drawing n winners without replacement, any one person's chance of being drawn is n/N, not 1/N.
map.去重抽取：避免同一人中多次，公平分配。: Deduplicated draw: avoid picking the same person twice for fair allocation.
map.不放回抽取：抽中的名字即从名单移除，同一人不会被重复抽中。: Without replacement: each drawn name is removed from the list, so nobody can win twice.
map.每行一个名字导入名单，设置抽中数量；名单内每行等概率，抽中即移出（不放回），因此: Import names one per line and set how many to draw; every line has equal probability and winners are removed (no replacement), so nobody is drawn twice. Frontend randomness with an open rolling animation boosts credibility.
map.50 人名单抽 3 名：单次第一名概率 = 1/50 = 2.0%；任意 1 人: From 50 people draw 3: the first-slot chance is 1/50 = 2.0%; any one person's chance of being drawn is 3/50 = 6.0% (each person has three chances to be picked). If one name is repeated on 3 lines, the total is 52 lines and their chance is higher than 3/52, so it is not a simple multiple of the line count.
